about.title: MATT — Matt Cloud Music
about.p1: My name is Arkadiusz, and I play as MATT. Music has been with me since childhood — it was always somewhere close, long before I ever thought about playing for anyone else. Over time, that interest turned into something more: I started collecting records, digging through old, forgotten recordings, searching for things nobody else had unearthed yet.
about.p2: Since 2015, I've been playing in bars, restaurants, and sometimes clubs — that's when this passion stepped out of my room and started living on the dancefloor.
about.p3: MATT CLOUD MUSIC is my project for sharing what I discover day to day in my collection and beyond. It's a space for everything that happens outside of live sets themselves — digging, rare finds, record stories, including folk and ethnic 7" singles I bring back from my travels.
about.p4: Gear is its own chapter of this story. Synthesizers, tape machines, turntables — I've always been drawn to analog things, to how they sound and how they're used. Over time I've gathered quite a bit of it, and a small studio came together at home, where I can test and record all of it. MATT CLOUD MUSIC is my way of showing what happens behind the scenes — before the music ever reaches the dancefloor.

rodo.p2: Legal bases: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent — optional cookies and SoundCloud), (b) (replying to an enquiry) and (f) (necessary site operation, e.g. remembering language).

rodo.more: Details are in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> and the <cookies>cookie policy</cookies>.

privacy.p1: Matt Cloud Music is an artist landing page. We do not collect accounts, a newsletter or a server-side contact form.
privacy.p2: Your browser may store the selected language and cookie choice. That is technical data, not a marketing profile we run.
privacy.p3: If you contact us by email or phone, the message is used only to reply. We do not pass it on except as required by email or hosting providers.
privacy.p4: After consent, the site may load the SoundCloud player. SoundCloud processes data under its own policy:

cookies.p1: Cookies (and similar storage such as localStorage) are small files or entries in your browser. We use them as described below.
cookies.p2: You can change your choice in the site footer (“Cookie settings”). Refusing optional cookies does not block browsing, but it disables the embedded player.
cookies.p3: Third-party cookies (SoundCloud) are outside our full control. Their lifetime and scope are set by SoundCloud.
